Video.title: Video
Video.description: Video metadata and storage path records for streaming

description.description: Detailed description of the video content

thumbnailPath.description: Storage or public URL path to video poster thumbnail

storagePath.description: Cloud Storage path or stream URI of the video file

isActive.description: Whether the video is active and available for streaming

totalViews.description: Total number of views accumulated by this video

uploadedBy.description: Identifier of the admin or creator member who uploaded the video

AccessLink.title: AccessLink
AccessLink.description: Unique token access link granting permission to stream a video

linkId.description: Unique identifier of the access link document

videoId.description: Identifier of the video referenced by this access link

tokenHash.description: Secure hash or token representation of the access key

isActive.description: Whether this access link is active or deactivated by admin

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the link was created

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp or null for permanent links

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized administrator user profile and role definition

role.description: Role level such as admin or superadmin

isActive.description: Whether this admin account is active

Member.title: Member
Member.description: Authorized creator member account with admin-managed earning balance

memberId.description: Unique identifier of the creator member

role.description: Account role chosen by Superadmin: Creator (member) or Sub-Admin (admin)

allowedOptions.description: List of panel option keys explicitly granted to this user

isActive.description: Whether this member account is active

totalEarning.description: Total INR earning credited and shown by admin on the creator dashboard

creditedViews.description: Admin-credited view count displayed on the creator dashboard (kept separate from actual admin-only video views)

viewRatePer1000.description: Admin payout rate in INR per 1,000 credited views (defaults to 190)

WithdrawalRequest.title: WithdrawalRequest
WithdrawalRequest.description: Creator UPI payout withdrawal request with minimum 500 INR threshold

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the withdrawal request

memberId.description: Creator memberId who requested the payout

upiId.description: Creator UPI ID for receiving payout

status.description: Current payout processing state managed by admin

adminNote.description: Optional UTR reference or note added by admin

requestedAt.description: Server timestamp when withdrawal was requested

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin last updated payout status

AppNotification.title: AppNotification
AppNotification.description: Broadcast announcement notification sent by Superadmin to all VidVora app users

notificationId.description: Unique identifier of the broadcast notification

message.description: Body message shown in system tray and in-app announcement banner

imageUrl.description: Optional image URL or encoded banner image attached to the notification

actionUrl.description: Optional clickable URL or deep link attached to the notification

sentBy.description: Identifier of the admin who sent the broadcast

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when notification was broadcast

isActive.description: Whether this broadcast notification is active

AppInstall.title: AppInstall
AppInstall.description: App-scoped anonymous installation and heartbeat record used to compute downloads, active installs, and estimated uninstalls without hardware identifiers

installId.description: Random app-scoped UUID generated on first launch (wiped on uninstall)

firstInstalledAt.description: Server timestamp of initial app install/download

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of latest app open heartbeat

deviceLabel.description: Non-identifying device manufacturer and model label

sessionCount.description: Number of heartbeat sessions recorded for this installation

isMarkedUninstalled.description: Optional admin override flag indicating uninstalled or retired install record

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Global VidVora configuration including main and category-wise Telegram channel links

telegramLink.description: Main official VidVora Telegram channel URL

categoryLinks.description: Map of built-in category keys (pakistani_drama, south_movie, ullu_tv_series, bhojpuri_movie, adult_content) to Telegram URL

customCategories.description: Ordered list of admin-added custom Telegram categories ({id, name, link})

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when Telegram configuration was last updated

SupportChat.title: SupportChat
SupportChat.description: User-to-Admin live support chat thread metadata

userName.description: Display name entered by user or Guest

lastMessage.description: Preview of the latest message in the thread

lastSenderRole.description: Role of sender of latest message (user or admin)

lastMessageAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when chat thread was started

unreadByAdminCount.description: Number of unread user messages awaiting admin review

unreadByUserCount.description: Number of unread admin replies for the user

SupportMessage.title: SupportMessage
SupportMessage.description: Individual support chat message sent by a user or replied by admin

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent

CreatorEvent.title: CreatorEvent
CreatorEvent.description: Gift, bonus, or contest announcement published by Admin for Creators

eventId.description: Unique identifier of the creator event

description.description: Full event details, rules, and gift announcement description

giftLabel.description: Optional short gift or reward tag shown on the event card

imageUrl.description: Optional banner image URL or base64 data URI

createdBy.description: Identifier of the Admin who created the event

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when event was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when event was last updated

isActive.description: Whether the event is currently live and visible to creators

/videos/{videoId}.description: Collection of all video records and metadata

/accessLinks/{linkId}.description: Collection of unique video access tokens and validity status

/members/{memberId}.description: Collection of authorized creator members and their admin-assigned earnings

/withdrawalRequests/{requestId}.description: Collection of creator UPI withdrawal requests and admin payout statuses

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Collection of Superadmin broadcast notifications delivered to all app downloaders

/appInstalls/{installId}.description: Collection of app installation & activity heartbeat records for Admin install analytics

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Global app configuration including main and category-wise Telegram channel links

/supportChats/{chatId}.description: Collection of user-to-admin support chat threads

/supportChats/{chatId}/messages/{message.description: Subcollection of real-time messages within a support chat thread

/creatorEvents/{eventId}.description: Collection of gift and announcement events visible in the Creator Portal
